name: Unchained
main_effect:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[End of Your Turn] 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into [ExMaquinamon] in the hand. Then, this Tamer may ＜Mind Link＞ with 1 of your Digimon with [Maquinamon] in its text. (Place this Tamer as that Digimon's bottom digivolution card if there are no Tamer cards in its digivolution cards.)
source_effect:
[All Turns] This Digimon with [Maquinamon] in its text can't have less than 1000 DP, and your opponent's effects can't trash its stacked cards.
[End of All Turns] You may play 1 [Unchained] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
set_name: EX-11: Extra Booster Dawn of Liberator
